title: Reproducibility code and data for Temporal filtering of dispersive stiffness in compacton collisions: coherent-scattering benchmarks and accuracy–cost tradeoffs
description: Code, raw and processed data, production sources, figure scripts, provenance and verification for temporal filtering, dispersive stiffness, compacton collisions, corrected generalized-alpha damping experiments, Jacobian scaling, robustness screens, coherent-core benchmarks and accuracy-cost tradeoffs.
